ppi_focus: Rear subframe mounting points, trunk-floor spot welds and diff-mount ears: look for cracking, tearing or prior repair.
Cooling system: pressure test, expansion tank and radiator neck cracks, water-pump play, thermostat operation.
VANOS: idle rattle and cold-start behaviour; scan for fault codes.
Valve cover gasket, oil filter housing gasket and oil pan: check for leaks.
Rear trailing-arm bushings, rear shock mounts and differential mounts.
Clutch engagement, flywheel chatter and trans/engine mounts.
Rust at rockers, floors and jacking points; paint meter for accident repair.
Soft top, rear window, top mechanism and window regulators.
Tire date codes and matching brands; alignment wear pattern.
Differential noise, which ties to the ring-gear-bolt recall.
what_would_change_verdict: Up: a clean history report plus invoices for cooling refresh and documented subframe reinforcement or a clean specialist inspection of the rear structure.
Up: price negotiated into or below the fair-value band.
Down: evidence of subframe cracking, an accident, or an odometer/title issue on the history report.
Down: seller declines a PPI, or the explanation for the failed sale reveals a mechanical problem.
evidence.mission_note: This is exactly the preferred keeper type (S52 manual M Roadster, close to home), but at an above-market asking price it is a keeper purchase, not a bridge. It conflicts with cash preservation while the 335i still needs replacing.
evidence.rationale: The captured evidence establishes identity: a 1999 Z3 M Roadster whose public VIN decodes cleanly, with about 46,452 stated miles, located in San Ramon, CA. Only the first attached photo appears to show this car. It shows an apparently straight, stock black example on correct Style 40 wheels; the other photos are marketplace ads and unrelated vehicles. Nothing is observed wrong mechanically, but nothing model-critical is documented either. There are no rear-subframe/trunk-floor records and no cooling history, and S54 rod bearings do not apply to this S52 car. The asking price of $24,990 is above the mileage-adjusted fair-value band of $18,105–$23,555. The tracker also shows a same-day 'sold' event followed by a relist at the same price, which needs an explanation. Because the detail page was not captured, records may exist in the full listing; the history report, receipts and a specialist PPI remain open.
evidence.next_action: Message the seller asking for the free history report, any cooling and rear-subframe records with trunk-floor photos, and the reason the car relisted. Then book a BMW-specialist PPI in the East Bay before any payment.
